title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
corresponding plant.

You can use all Service Processing (CS-SE ) functions in the service orders/service notifications, as well as print them, and
download them to another system. IS-U/CCS data is also available to you.

Service orders are generated using the same procedure described in the Work Management section.

Prerequisites

If you want to generate a disconnection order, the disconnection document must have a reference object containing devices or
flat-rate installations in its data environment.

In the event that open item accounting is blocked, the contract account must contain at least one current contract when the
disconnection order is generated.

Features

During generation of a disconnection order, you enter a planned disconnection date and the number of devices or flat-rate
installations to be disconnected.

The system proposes all potential disconnection objects from the data environment of the reference object. In the disconnection
processing variant, you can determine whether this proposal is to be division-dependent (according to the items of the contract
account that are relevant to disconnection).

Disconnection orders cannot contain any installations or devices, for which a reason for guarantee of supply has been specified.
The same is true for disconnection objects that are already disconnected. You can generate a disconnection order for devices that
are allocated to installations other than the installation from the environment of the reference object. However, a warning will be
displayed so that the disconnection will not inadvertently affect other customers.

The Planned Disconnection Date and Time

When you create a disconnection order, you specify a planned disconnection date and time ( Plan. Disc. Date and Disc.Time
fields), indicating when an agent (or the system — in the case of remote disconnections) is to process the device disconnection.

The Agreed Date and Time

If notification is required, the system generates a notification work item . When the CRM agent assigned to this work item
contacts the customer, the customer can agree to the planned disconnection date and time, or propose a different one. The final
date and time agreed upon by both the CRM agent and the customer are called the agreed date and agreed time.

e The agreed date and time can equal the planned disconnection date and time

e The agreed date and time can be earlier than the planned disconnection date and time — in this case, the agreed date and
time must fall on or after the current date and time.

e The agreed date and time can be later than the planned disconnection date and time — in this case, the agreed date must
fall on or before:

o The maximum agreed date — this date is calculated by adding the planned disconnection date to the maximum
agreed offset
